I haven't started the comparison, because I can't pick the competitors. This tool only compares against competitors you name. That holds even when you tell me to choose.

The reason is practical. A comparison against the wrong sites still looks confident and finished. Once a name I guessed is in the matrix, nobody reading the report can tell it was a guess and not your actual competitive picture. I'm also not going to suggest names for you to approve, because that's still me choosing.

Two ways forward:

1. **Give me 1–3 competitor URLs.** Your sales team or a quick check of who you lose deals to is usually enough, and "the one we keep losing to" is a good choice. Then I'll show you the scope and time estimate (two competitors comes to roughly 1.5 hours across capture, scoring and the comparison) and wait for your go-ahead.
2. **Assess just your site.** If you'd rather not name anyone, I can run a website assessment of `https://example-nimbus-notes.test` on its own through `/understudy:run`, with the same lenses but no comparison table.

Either way, only public pages get looked at. No accounts are created and no forms are submitted on any site.

Which would you like?
